confirm.title: Please confirm
login.help: If you forget it, run kaze-syncd admin-password on the server to reset it.
notif.offlineAdvice: Bring the device online, or revoke it
notif.footer: Notifications are computed from the current state and go away when the cause is gone.
fold.link-not-created: {n} symbolic links not created (Windows needs Developer Mode)
fold.link-not-created.1: {n} symbolic link not created (Windows needs Developer Mode)
advice.rejected: Rename it on that client (to a name that does not clash in case, or without the illegal characters), or exclude it with a rule
advice.io: Check that client's disk or permissions as the message says
advice.folder: Mount the disk, or change the path or allow adopting on the device page
advice.in_use: Close the program that holds the file; for a SQLite database, close the application first
advice.skipped: If you do not need it, exclude it with a rule
advice.conflict: Compare the two on any client, then delete the conflict copy or rename it to keep both
ov.name: Name
nf.help: The name of the synced folder, up to 64 bytes. After creating it, map it to a local directory on a device from the device page.
ad.help: Letters, digits, - and _; it appears in the file names of conflict copies. The enrollment command is shown after you submit.
en.title: Enroll device {name}
en.note: Run one of the commands on the device. When enrollment finishes, the device appears in the device table by itself; then add mappings for it on its device page.
dev.noFree: No folder to add: every folder is already mapped to this device; create a folder in Overview first
dev.delMapConfirm: Delete this mapping? The client stops syncing it and deletes its local state database and marker file; the files on the machine are left as they are.
dev.revokeConfirm: Revoke device {name}? Its token stops working at once and all its mappings are deleted; the files on the machine are left as they are.
ma.title: Add mapping
ma.note: If the directory does not exist, the client creates it. If it is not empty and is not already a synced directory, reconciliation starts only when "Allow adopting a non-empty directory" is ticked (for moving over from another sync tool). This keeps a path mistyped as a whole home directory from being uploaded in full.
me.title: Edit mapping
me.help: Changing the path is the same as deleting the old mapping and adding a new one: the files at the old path stay as they are, and the new path is reconciled afresh.
fo.emptyUnmapped: No device syncs this folder yet. Add a mapping for a device on its device page and syncing starts.
fo.emptyDeleted: This directory has no files and no deleted files
fo.restoreLastConfirm: Restore the last content of this deleted file? It will be synced to all devices as a new file.
fo.delConfirm: Permanently delete folder {name} and all its version history? Its blocks are reclaimed at the next cleanup.
pv.count: Files that existed then and differ now: {n}
pv.same: No difference between then and now
pv.firstImport: The selected time is before the earliest record; the state when the first import finished is used. The first import finished {time}
pv.firstRecord: The selected time is before the earliest record; the earliest record is used. It is from {time}
rs.title: Restore to a point in time
rs.note1: Only content is restored; files created after that time are not deleted. The current content goes into the version history and can be restored again.
rs.noteNoJs: Time zone UTC; change it in Settings. Versions are kept for {d} days.
rs.noteNoJs.1: Time zone UTC; change it in Settings. Versions are kept for {d} day.
ru.title: Exclusion rules of {name}
ru.help: gitignore syntax, one rule per line; lines starting with # are comments. They follow the global rules and the last matching rule wins. Content under an excluded directory cannot be included again, so write !/dir/ first, then /dir/*, then !/dir/file.
ru.global: Global rules ({n}, read-only, edit them in Settings)
hits.changed: The matching files have changed; please check again.
hits.warn: Preview, not in effect yet: saving deletes the {n} files on the server that these rules match, at once (they go into the version history and can be restored within the retention period). The local files on the devices stay and are no longer synced.
hits.warn.1: Preview, not in effect yet: saving deletes the {n} file on the server that these rules match, at once (it goes into the version history and can be restored within the retention period). The local files on the devices stay and are no longer synced.
hits.count: Files on the server that match: {n}
hits.zero: Preview, not in effect yet: no file on the server matches.
ver.title: Version history
ver.ask: Restore this version? The current content goes into the version history
ver.conflictNote: This is a conflict copy: version history of {file}
un.title: Entries not synced
set.tzNote: Affects only how times are shown and entered in the Web UI
set.sample: Example: {time}. The server (OpenWrt, for one) often runs in UTC; times are converted in the browser, so the server needs no time zone data.
set.langNote: Affects only the Web UI; kept in this browser
set.keepNote: Overwritten or deleted old content is kept this long. After saving, versions that have expired under the new value are cleaned up at once.
set.rulesNote: Shared by all folders; a folder's rules follow them and can override with !
set.rulesHelp: gitignore syntax: # comment, ! negation, a trailing / matches only directories, a pattern containing / is relative to the folder root, ** any number of levels.
err.deviceName: A device name may use only letters, digits, - and _, up to 32 characters (it is part of the file names of conflict copies)
err.deviceDup: A device with this name exists
err.folderName: A folder name cannot be empty, is at most 64 bytes, and has no control characters
err.folderDup: A folder with this name exists
err.keepDays: The days to keep must be a whole number from 1 to 3650
err.timeZone: Invalid time zone name, for example UTC or Asia/Shanghai
err.folderMapped: The folder is still mapped to devices; delete the mappings on the device pages first
err.pathWindows: A Windows path must start with a drive letter, for example D:\Docs
err.pathLinux: A Linux path must start with /
err.pathOverlap: The path overlaps another mapping of this device, {path}
err.lock.overlap: {path} is already exclusive to {device}; exclusive ranges cannot overlap
flash.rulesDeleted: Exclusion rules saved; the server deleted {n} files
flash.rulesDeleted.1: Exclusion rules saved; the server deleted {n} file
flash.restoredFailed: Restored {n} files, {f} failed (name clash or changed at the same time)
flash.restoredFailed.1: Restored {n} file, {f} failed (name clash or changed at the same time)
js.axisFail: The timeline did not load; type a time instead
js.hint: Pick the day above, then the time of day below
js.filter: Filter by glob, e.g. *.md or src/**
js.fail: The preview did not load; please try again
js.old: The selected time is before the retention period; content from then may have been removed
js.note3: Versions are kept for {d} days; the earliest point is {from}.
js.note3.1: Versions are kept for {d} day; the earliest point is {from}.
js.previewFail: Cannot preview; check the rules and try again
js.discard: There are unsaved changes. Discard them and close?
js.menu.restoreAt: Restore to a point in time…
js.menu.restoreDir: Restore this directory to a point in time…
js.menu.restoreFolder: Restore the whole folder to a point in time…
js.menu.delFolderHint: {n} devices still map it; delete the mappings on the device pages first
js.menu.delFolderHint.1: {n} device still maps it; delete the mapping on its device page first
fo.locked.line: Exclusive to {device} since {time}, read-only on other devices
dlg.lock.title: Make exclusive
dlg.lock.help: Only changes from this device are uploaded. Other devices still receive them, with the files read-only; their own changes are refused by the server and moved to .syncsaved.
fold.locked: {n} changes to {path} refused (exclusive to {owner}), moved to .syncsaved
fold.locked.1: {n} change to {path} refused (exclusive to {owner}), moved to .syncsaved
advice.locked: These changes were not uploaded and are kept in .syncsaved on that device. Delete them if not needed; otherwise make the same change on {owner}, or remove the exclusive and copy them back
js.unlock.confirm: Release the exclusive of {device} on {path}? All devices can then change it, and the files become writable on the other devices.
js.restoreLocked: This range contains a directory exclusive to {device}; the restore applies there too and syncs to every device
